### Load Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)

"https://towardsdatascience.com/how-to-automatically-import-and-combine-multiple-files-in-r-30a77c0a7732/"
```


### Load files
```{r}
files <- list.files(path = "/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/DO/07092025/con_xlsx_files")


con <- data.frame()

for (file in files){
  name <- gsub(".xlsx","", file)
  con_file <- readxl::read_excel(paste("/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/DO/07092025/con_xlsx_files/",file,sep=""))
  con_file$sensor <- name
  con <- rbind(con, con_file)
}

colnames(con) <- c("datetime", "high_range", "temp", "spec_cond", "sal_ppt", "sensor")

```


```{r}

ggplot(con, aes(x=datetime, y=high_range, colour = sensor))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()

```
```{r}
con_current <- left_join(con, current, by = "datetime")

con_current$Immersed <- ifelse(con_current$up_speed < 10, "Y", "N" )

con_current %>%
  filter(Immersed == "Y") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=datetime, y=sal_ppt, colour = sensor))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()

```

```{r}


con_current %>%
  filter(Immersed == "Y") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=datetime, y=mean_con, colour = sensor))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()
```

hist(con_current$sal_ppt)
